title: Chat-only investment coaching, no call, clean payee
story: A 'SEBI-registered advisor' coaches him over WhatsApp chat only. After ₹15,000 and ₹30,000 and a ₹3,000 'profit', he is told to send ₹50,000 to a new 'escrow' account.
why: Rising series and a stranger credit, but no call and an unflagged payee. Only the journey family sees it; we expect at best a pause and no hold, and may miss it entirely.
